interpretation.timings: Pipeline time includes native export; later H265 publication is separate. PE is excluded.
interpretation.tokens: OpenH3 prompt_tokens and actual Qwen embedding rows are different measurements.
interpretation.memory: Process-tree RSS, CUDA allocator counters, sampled board memory and container counters are separate. Sampled peaks may miss transients.
interpretation.container: Working set is current-inactive_file and may include active file cache. It is not Python private RAM. Peaks in different columns need not occur together.
interpretation.inputs: Reference media are retained locally and are not distributed in this repository. SHA/shape/duration identify requests; substitute your own references for scale tests.
interpretation.precision: Mixed precision labels describe selected projections, not uniform MXFP8 for every operation.
interpretation.offload_counters: CPU reads, H2D stream events and compute can overlap; their durations are not additive wall-time components.

dit_profile.scope: 12 real DiT blocks, first step,15s input+15s output; separate prefix warmup; profiler overhead excluded from generation benchmarks
dit_profile.attribution_note: CPU API/record-function overlap plus actual CUDA correlation; queued-device wait remains scheduler/dependency ambiguous
dit_profile.window_definition: blocks1..12 of first real forward after block0; full separate identical prefix warmup before capture
dit_profile.utilization_scope: CUPTI CUDA timeline activity, not SM occupancy or Tensor Core utilization; not the full pipeline.
dit_profile.transfer_note: All four 128 MiB weight staging slots were pinned; pageable transfer baseline does not explain this profile.
dit_profile.profiler_overhead_measurement_note: Single warmup/profile wall-time comparison; the observed difference also includes run variance, not an isolated repeated-overhead measurement.
